info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities requestFile API
Send a Request File to Folder request

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the entity.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Initiates a Request File to Folder.
### Precondition:
  The user profile must have the necessary access rights to request files to the folder.
### Response:
  Successfully creates a request file and returns the request file details.

info.name: Returns Request File Info by ref

params.name: ref
params.description: The unique reference of the Request File upload link.

params.name: read
params.description: Indicates whether to log the view event. Defaults to true.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Retrieves detailed information about a Request File using the provided reference (ref).
### Precondition:
  The user must have valid authentication and appropriate access to view the request file information.
### Response:
  Returns the details of the specified request file, including its associated metadata and status.

params.name: ref

items.docs: Marks the request file link as expired, preventing any further file uploads through it. **Requires the authenticated user to be the user who created the request file link.**

info.name: Download files from folder in request files to folder message

params.name: ref
params.description: The unique reference of the Request File upload link.

params.name: object_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the file

items.docs:
Downloads a file that was made available to recipients as a source attachment in a
                       request files to folder message. Access is granted via the request file reference link
                       (`ref`).\n\nThe request link must be valid and not expired. If the request requires
                       authentication, the caller must be logged in. The file must not be deleted, infected,
                       or DLP-locked.

info.name: Get files uploaded by the current user

params.name: ref
params.description: The unique reference of the Request File upload link.

items.docs: Returns the list of files the currently authenticated user has uploaded for the specified request file link. Returns an empty list when the link does not require authentication (`require_auth=false`).

info.name: Download files uploaded to request files to folder or inbox message

params.name: ref
params.description: The unique reference of the Request File upload link.

params.name: object_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the file

items.docs:
Downloads a file that was uploaded to a request files to folder or inbox message. Access
                       is granted via the request file reference link (`ref`).\n\n**Authentication is required**
                       — guest access is not permitted for this endpoint. The file must be associated with the
                       specified request link, must not be deleted, and must not be infected or DLP-locked.

params.name: returnEntity
params.description: If true, includes the entity in the response body.

params.name: with
params.description: Specifies additional fields to include in the response.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Sends a request files to inbox message.
### Precondition:
  Must be assigned a user profile with the ability to request files to inbox.
### Response:
  Sends the message requesting files to your inbox.

params.name: ref
params.description: The unique reference of the Request File upload link.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Processes a reply to a specific Request File.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated and have the proper access to reply to the specified request file.
### Response:
  The reply to the request file is processed, and a successful response is returned with the status of the action.
